hero.tagline: Samar da Makamashi na Gaba ga Afirka
hero.description: A.R. Sahel Energy Ltd kamfani ne na makamashi da ke ƙware wajen shigo da fitar da kayayyakin man fetur da makamashi a duk faɗin Yammacin Afirka da yankin Sahel.

about.title: Samar da Hanyoyin Makamashi a Sahel
about.description: An yi rajista da Hukumar Harkokin Kamfanoni (RC 8589712), A.R. Sahel Energy Ltd tana da hedikwata a Sokoto, Nigeria. Mun jajirce wajen tabbatar da ingantaccen sarƙar samar da makamashi a duk faɗin Yammacin Afirka.
about.missionText: Zama abokin ciniki na makamashi mafi aminci kuma mafi inganci a yankin Sahel, muna isar da kayayyakin man fetur da makamashi na inganci.
about.visionText: Canza hanyar samun makamashi a duk Yammacin Afirka, ƙirƙirar hanyoyin samar da abin dogaro waɗanda ke ƙarfafa haɓakar tattalin arziki.
about.valuesText: Gaskiya, aminci, da ƙwarewa su ne tushen kowane ciniki da alaƙar da muke ginawa.

services.title: Cikakkun Hanyoyin Makamashi
services.description: Daga shigo da fitar da man fetur zuwa rarraba kayayyakin makamashi, muna ba da cikakkun hanyoyin magance matsalolin makamashi.
services.service1Desc: Tsarin nemo da shigo da kayayyakin man fetur masu inganci daga masu samarwa a duniya.
services.service2Desc: Ingantattun ayyukan fitar da kayayyakin da ke haɗa kayayyakin makamashi na yankin Sahel zuwa kasuwannin duniya.
services.service3Desc: Babbar hanyar rarraba da ke tabbatar da isar da kaya cikin lokaci a duk Nigeria da ƙasashen maƙwabta.
services.service4Desc: Inganta sarƙar samarwa daga farko zuwa ƙarshe don tabbatar da kwararar kayayyakin makamashi.
services.service5Desc: Tsauraran ƙa'idojin kula da inganci waɗanda ke tabbatar da cewa kowane kaya ya cika ƙa'idojin ƙasa da ƙasa.
services.service6Desc: Shawarar ƙwararru kan yanayin kasuwar makamashi, bin doka, da tsara dabaru don kasuwancin makamashi.

regions.title: Hidima a Tsakiyar Afirka
regions.description: Ayyukanmu sun bazu a duk Yammacin Afirka da babban yankin Sahel, suna haɗa kasuwannin makamashi.

contact.title: Mu Samar da Makamashi ga Kasuwancinka
contact.description: Kuna shirye ku tattauna buƙatun makamashi? Tuntuɓe mu mu bincika yadda za mu yi aiki tare.

footer.companyDesc: A.R. Sahel Energy Ltd — Shigo da Fitar da Kayayyakin Man Fetur & Makamashi. Samar da makamashi na gaba ga Afirka daga zuciyar Sahel.
